title: Scout entry (schema 1)
description: One structure, two types ("pack" | "step"), discriminated by the "type" field. See docs/prd.md §6. This schema is a tolerant reader's contract: additionalProperties is true everywhere on purpose so future fields never fail validation (docs/research/file-format-patterns.md §A.6) — the code-level tolerant reader is what actually preserves and round-trips them. Field-by-field accretion-only evolution rules and the reserved-name registry live in schema/RESERVED.md.

schema.description: Schema version, integer (not semver). Always 1 for this version. No default — every entry must state it explicitly so future readers know which contract produced the file.

id.description: Stable slug, kebab-case. No default — assigned at creation and never changed. Never reused after retirement; see schema/RESERVED.md.

type.description: Discriminator. "pack" = an analyzed link (library/effect/tool/skill) that surfaces conditionally. "step" = a project practice executed at project start or followed as a standing instruction. No default — must be chosen at creation; it determines which of the pack-only/step-only fields below are required.

title.description: Display name shown on cards, in listings, and in the manifest. No default.

status.description: Default: "active". Archived entries leave the manifest and match pool immediately but retain full history and can always be reactivated (PRD §5.7).

superseded_by.description: Default: null. Set to the id of the successor entry when this entry is archived in favor of something else; null when there is no successor (including on active entries).

notes.description: Default: null. The user's own words: why this was saved, caveats, overlap notes captured at ingest time.

added.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) the entry was first captured. No default — always set at creation, never rewritten.

verified.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last verification of the source. No default — set at creation, refreshed only by an explicit lazy re-verify (PRD §5.2).

dismissals.description: Default: 0. Count of times a report for this entry was ignored in a similar context (D-008). Increments only; an archive nudge fires at threshold (default 3, D-009) but the counter itself is never auto-reset.

url.description: Pack-only. Default: null (must be null/absent on step entries). Source URL; required on pack entries.

repo.description: Pack-only, and optional even on pack entries (per PRD §6 example). Default: null. Repository URL when distinct from url — e.g. a docs site's url with a separate GitHub repo.

stack.description: Pack-only. Default: null (must be null/absent on step entries). Recorded at ingest, never enforced as a filter (PRD §4); an empty array means "stack recorded as not applicable," distinct from null meaning "not recorded."

install.description: Pack-only. Default: null (must be null/absent on step entries). Install string, e.g. "npm i dialkit"; required on pack entries.

summary.description: Pack-only. Default: null (must be null/absent on step entries). 2-3 sentences: what it is and what it's good at; required on pack entries.

surfaces_when.description: Pack-only. Default: null (must be null/absent on step entries). Machine-side match conditions generated at ingest; required (non-empty) on pack entries — this is the field the surfacing gate matches against.

ambient_line.description: Pack-only. Default: null (must be null/absent on step entries). The one-liner that earns this entry a slot in the manifest (hard-capped at ~25 lines, PRD §5.3); required on pack entries.

instruction.description: Step-only. Default: null (must be null/absent on pack entries). Imperative practice text; required on step entries.

phase.description: Step-only. Default: null (must be null/absent on pack entries). When the step executes; required on step entries. "init" steps run once at /scout start; "ongoing"/"milestone" steps render into the standing-instructions block; "wrap" steps run at project close (PRD §5.3, §5.4).

automation.description: Step-only, and optional even on step entries. Default: null (must be null/absent on pack entries). Script or skill path if this step is automated rather than purely a standing instruction.

produces.description: Step-only, and optional even on step entries. Default: null (must be null/absent on pack entries). Artifact created/maintained by this step, e.g. "CHANGELOG.md".
